a.xlink:title: MainWindow implementation — UI setup, theming, toolbar actions, VR lifecycle.
Main application window — parts browser, 3D viewport, properties panel, VR controls.
Declares OptionDialog — modal editor for part name, colour, visibility, and filters.
Declares ModelPart — one STL part with its VTK pipeline, filters, and display state.
Declares ModelPartList — the QAbstractItemModel that backs the QTreeView.
Declares VRRenderThread — runs the OpenVR render loop on a dedicated thread.
